messages:
Priya (Docs): Heads up — small docs fix for rate-limit examples + SDK migration. Found a broken link to the dashboard panel and an out-of-date v1 snippet in the Quotas > Migration guide. Adding a brief note about tiered-slabs behavior.

Priya (Docs): Current draft snippet: ```python
# OLD v1 example - outdated
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key="$REDWOOD_KEY")
resp = client.rate_limits.get_usage(customer_id="acct_123", window="2026-03")
print(resp)
```

Omar (Eng-API): Thanks — v1 call renamed to usage.list in v2. New quick snippet: ```python
# v2 SDK
from redwood import Redwood
rd = Redwood(api_key="$REDWOOD_KEY")
csv = rd.usage.export_csv(window_start="2026-03-01T00:00:00Z", window_end="2026-03-31T23:59:59Z", group_by="tier_slabs")
print(csv)
```

Priya (Docs): Great. Also the dashboard link on the page points to /dashboards/rl-old which 404s. Hector can we point to the new panel slug?

Hector (DevEx): Yep the new slug is /dashboards/rate-quotas-overview. I'll push a redirect in the docs site config.

Maya (Analytics): Small note for the migration guide: when customers move from enterprise->standard mid-window we currently allocate usage to the allocation_at_start by default; add caveat about prorate opt-in.

Lena (Billing): And call out billing vs reporting: invoices use the committed tier for billing windows. Docs should include a one-line caveat so users aren't confused when the CSV doesn't match invoice totals.

Priya (Docs): Proposed copy for the caveat: "Reporting exports show usage attribution and can be configured to prorate across tier changes; invoices are generated against committed tiers and may differ." Good?

Omar (Eng-API): LGTM. Tiny nit for snippet: include timezone (UTC) in examples.

Priya (Docs): Will add UTC note, switch to v2 snippet, fix link slug, and add the billing caveat. Opening PR now.

Priya (Docs): PR: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/3388 — adds v2 snippet, redirect for the dashboard link, and a short migration note. Reviewers: @Omar @Maya @Lena

Omar (Eng-API): Reviewing, small request — add example curl for customers who don't use the SDK.

Priya (Docs): Added curl quick example and a minimal test-case note. Merging once approved. Thanks all :sparkles:

Maya (Analytics): Verified wording for prorate caveat. :+1:

Lena (Billing): Approved.

Hector (DevEx): Redirect pushed.

Priya (Docs): Merged. Closing thread.
